title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-21
lineage: Lineage: CD > Wavelab 6 > wav 16/44.1 > iZotope RX4 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > Flac 16
source: Sony F95's > Sony TC124 > Master Cassette - Recorded by Ken and Judy Lee

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience recording of an early‑70s three‑set show, highlighted by stellar Casey Jones, Dancing in the Street and Cosmic Charlie performances
ai_review.review: The tape is a cleaned‑up audience source that still suffers from modest speed/pitch wobble but sounds clear enough for listening. Musically the concert ranks as a strong outing – the first set rocks with a crisp Casey Jones, the second delivers a wildly good Cosmic Charlie and an outstanding Katie Mae, while the third offers one of the year’s best Saint Stephen sequences despite a lackluster Midnight Hour.

ai_rating.rationale: Three detailed reviews give a consistent picture: the performance is well‑above average (≈4.3/5) and the restored audience recording, while not perfect, is good enough (≈3.8/5). Weighted together this yields ~4.2 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No soundboard source; patched and EQ’d from an audience tape. Notable wobbly speed/pitch issues requiring +1‑2% correction on several tracks, but overall clear after cleanup.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set marathon with a tight, upbeat first set, a varied second set that includes the fan‑favorite Katie Mae, and a third set that peaks with Cosmic Charlie and Saint Stephen before fading on a bland Midnight Hour.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Smiles knowingly at the cop; later meanders on single notes in Midnight Hour and riffs over Not Fade Away.
